sentiment.label: risk_off
sentiment.reason_it: Il VIX a 19,45 (+2,21) indica un mercato difensivo ma non ancora in panico; il S&P 500 è sceso del -0,52% e il TLT 20Y ha perso -0,49%, segnale di pressione sui risk assets. Il DXY è in lieve debolezza a 101,69 (-0,12%), favorendo le commodity, ma il Brent è in forte calo a $109,78 (-5,95%), generando un impatto bearish sul sentiment. L'oro in rialzo a $4.017 (+0,24%) offre un rifugio misto. Le view istituzionali di BlackRock e Goldman Sachs, contenute nei report settimanali, evidenziano una cautela sul ciclo di rialzo e una preferenza per asset difensivi, rafforzando il tono risk‑off.
sentiment.reason_en: The VIX at 19.45 (+2.21) points to a defensive market without panic; the S&P 500 fell -0.52% and the 20‑year TLT dropped -0.49%, indicating pressure on risk assets. The DXY is slightly weaker at 101.69 (-0.12%), which supports commodities, yet Brent plunged to $109.78 (-5.95%), delivering a bearish shock to sentiment. Gold rose to $4,017 (+0.24%) offering a mixed safe‑haven. Institutional outlooks from BlackRock and Goldman Sachs weekly reports stress caution on the upside cycle and a tilt toward defensive assets, reinforcing a risk‑off tone.

market_impact_summary.it: Equity: S&P 500 -0,52% e STOXX 600 -0,35% riflettono la pressione dei tassi US (US 10Y a 4,98% +0,71%) e il calo del Brent (-5,95%). Fixed Income: TLT 20Y -0,49% segnala un rialzo dei rendimenti, mentre il BTP 10Y resta stabile al 3,99%. Commodity: Brent -5,95% e oro +0,24% mostrano una divergenza; il DXY in lieve debolezza (-0,12%) sostiene le commodity, ma il forte spike del petrolio resta bearish. Le analisi di BlackRock e Goldman Sachs sottolineano una preferenza per asset difensivi e una cautela sul ciclo di crescita, confermando il bias risk‑off.
market_impact_summary.en: Equities: S&P 500 -0.52% and STOXX 600 -0.35% mirror pressure from US rates (US 10Y at 4.98% +0.71%) and the Brent plunge (-5.95%). Fixed Income: 20‑yr TLT -0.49% signals rising yields, while Italy's 10Y BTP holds at 3.99%. Commodities: Brent -5.95% and gold +0.24% diverge; the DXY's slight weakness (-0.12%) backs commodities, yet the oil spike remains bearish. BlackRock and Goldman Sachs reports stress defensive positioning and caution on growth, reinforcing the risk‑off bias.

The cost of shipping crude oil from the U.S. Gulf Coast to China soared to as high as $80 million earlier this month. Seasonal relief from Gulf producers and additional Chinese export allowances could ease the squeeze towards year-end, particularly for very-low-sulphur fuel oil. articles.title: Interest rates unlikely to reach 4.75% by next summer, say City economists
articles.snippet: Experts say Bank of England unlikely to increase rates by full percentage point – and could lower them by end of 2027 Financial markets are wrong to predict the Bank of England will raise UK interest rates by a full percentage point or more by next summer, City economists believe. According to market-implied interest rate expectations, the Bank is likely to raise interest rates at least four times over the next year, lifting the bank rate from 3.75% today to 4.75% by the end of July, and possibly to 5% – meaning five rises – by December 2027.
